name: LinnDrum gated backbeat
desc: 1984 in a drum pattern: AkaiLinn kick on 1 and 3, huge gated-reverb snare on 2 and 4 (big room, tight tail), straight 8th hats. Full adds a ghost kick and a tom pickup every other bar; peak runs simmons-style tom cascades every 4th bar. Drive-soundtrack tempo.

code.full: stack(s("<[bd ~ bd ~] [bd ~ [bd bd] ~]>").bank("AkaiLinn").shape(.35).gain(${gain}), s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("AkaiLinn").room(${verb}).size(.9).shape(.25).gain(${gain}*.9), s("hh*8").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(saw.range(${hats}*.55, ${hats}).fast(4)).lpf(sine.range(4000,8000).slow(32)), s("~ ~ ~ [~ mt]").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(.35).mask("<0 1>")).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("<[bd ~ bd ~] [bd ~ [bd bd] ~]>").bank("AkaiLinn").shape(.4).gain(${gain}), s("~ [sd,cp] ~ [sd,cp]").bank("AkaiLinn").room(${verb}).size(.92).shape(.3).gain(${gain}*.95), s("hh*8").bank("AkaiLinn").ply("<1 1 1 2>").gain(saw.range(${hats}*.6, ${hats}).fast(4)), s("<[~ ~ ~ ~] [~ ~ ~ ~] [~ ~ ~ ~] [~ ~ [ht mt] [mt lt]]>").bank("AkaiLinn").room(.4).gain(${gain}*.75)).orbit(1).play()
